text: 9月28日至29日，亚洲基础设施投资银行第十一届理事会年会在卡塔尔多哈举行。本次年会主题为“未来基础设施：影响与创新”，与会成员代表围绕亚投行加大基础设施投融资力度、进一步增强发展效益和效率、更好帮助成员应对挑战等议题开展讨论。亚投行中国理事、财政部部长蓝佛安以视频方式出席年会并发言。蓝佛安指出，在全体成员的支持下，亚投行顺利实现管理层平稳过渡，开启了新的发展征程。面对国际局势变乱交织，发展赤字有增无减，亚投行要坚持多边主义不动摇，大家的事大家商量着办；坚持初心使命不动摇，持之以恒推进落实机构战略重点；坚持高标准运营不动摇，着力提高项目质量和发展效益。作
text_en: From September 28 to 29, the 11th Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors of the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank was held in Doha, Qatar. The theme of this annual meeting was "Infrastructure for the Future: Impact and Innovation." Representatives of member countries discussed topics including the AIIB increasing infrastructure investment and financing, further enhancing development benefits and efficiency, and better helping members address challenges. Lan Fo'an, China's Governor at the AIIB and Minister of Finance, attended the annual meeting by video and delivered remarks. Lan Fo'an pointed out that with the support of all members, the AIIB has smoothly achieved a stable management transition and embarked on a new journey of development. In the face of a turbulent and intertwined international situation and a growing development deficit, the AIIB should remain unwavering in upholding multilateralism and handle everyone's affairs through consultation; remain unwavering in its original aspiration and mission and persistently advance the implementation of the institution's strategic priorities; and remain unwavering in high-standard operations and focus on improving project quality and development benefits.
